issue.detail: Spec says capture 1->0 transitions; contract uses prev_in & ~in. Alternative semantics: capture any bit that is 0 in current cycle and was 1 in any earlier cycle (sticky until reset), not just immediate previous cycle.
issue.spec_evidence: capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next
issue.alternative: Set out[i] when in[i]==0 and out[i] was previously set or in[i] was 1 in any prior cycle since reset (i.e., detect any 0 after a 1, not only immediate 1->0).
